source.table: Table B-2. Summary Measures by Selected Characteristics Using Money Income and Post-Tax Income: 2023
source.title: Percent difference in median income (post-tax income less money income)

unit_note: Percent-difference block of Table B-2: every cell is a derived comparison of the money-income and post-tax medians (ratio arithmetic, outside the frozen relation vocabulary) or its MOE; all cells standalone. Printed asterisk significance markers are table apparatus and are stripped from values.
